harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: «إنما»: a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), having no governing effect. «إذا» is purely adverbial (ẓarfiyya maḥḍa), and the clause «دُعُوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The genitive maṣdar «ليحكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «دُعُوا». The interpreted maṣdar «أن يقولوا» is the noun of kāna. The wāw in «وأولئك» is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), and «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); the clause «وأولئك هم المفلحون» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ}. «مَنْ» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يطع» is its khabar (predicate). «ويتقه» is jussive (majzūm) by dropping of the weak letter, because it ends in a weak letter; its original form is «ويتقِه», then it was given sukūn for lightness because of the many vowels. They treated a separable [sequence] such as «ويتقه» like a single word such as «كَبِد»: they give sukūn to the ʿayn of faʿil and say «كَبْد», because it is a single word, and then they treated what resembles it among separable sequences in the same way as a single word. For in «يتقِه» there came to be «تَقِهِ», equivalent to «كَتِف», so it was given sukūn as that is given sukūn. «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «جهد» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. أقسموا إقسام اجتهاد (they swore with a strenuous swearing). The clause «لئن أمرتهم ليخرجن» is explicative (tafsīriyya) of the content of the oath; the lām in «لئن» paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam). «يخرجن» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the presence of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath. «طاعة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. طاعة معروفة أمثل بكم (a known obedience is more fitting for you). The clause «طاعة معروفة أمثل» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «ما» is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «فإن تولَّوا» is resumptive, and the clause «وما على الرسول إلا البلاغ» is resumptive: the wāw is resumptive, «ما» is negating and inoperative (muhmala), «البلاغ» is a mubtadaʾ, the preposition «على الرسول» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and «إلا» is restrictive (li-l-ḥaṣr).

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The second object of the promise is omitted, i.e. الاستخلاف (the granting of succession). The clause «ليستخلفنَّهم» is the response to the oath (jawāb al-qasam). The kāf in «كما» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), i.e. استخلافا مثل استخلاف الذين (a succession like the succession of those…). «أمْنًا» is the second object. The clause «يعبدونني» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «يبدِّلنهم», and the clause «لا يشركون» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «يعبدون». The clause «ومن كفر» is conjoined to the clause «وعد الله», and the clause «كفر» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «من».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «وأقيموا» is conjoined to the clause {أَطِيعُوا} in verse (54); the clause «لعلكم ترحمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «لا» is prohibitive; [then] an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the jussive. «معجزين» is the second object; the preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «معجزين». The clause «ومأواهم النار» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «لا تحسبن»; conjoining a declarative to an injunctive is permissible. As for «ولبئس المصير»: the wāw is resumptive, and the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; [then] a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the specified [noun] (makhṣūṣ) is omitted, i.e. جهنم (Hell). The clause «ولبئس المصير» is the response to the oath (jawāb al-qasam), and the clause «ووالله لبئس المصير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «الذين» is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of the one addressed (munādā). The clause «ليستأذنكم» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. «والذين» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding relative noun; the preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw. «ثلاث» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The preposition «من قبل» is attached to «يستأذن»; «حين» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to «يستأذن»; and the preposition «من بعد» is attached to «يستأذن». «ثلاث» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هي ثلاث, and the clause is resumptive. The preposition «لكم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «عورات». The clause «ليس عليكم جناح» is a naʿt of «ثلاث». «بعدهن» is an adverb attached to the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. «طوَّافون» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. هم, and the clause is resumptive; the preposition «عليكم» is attached to «طوافون». «بعضكم» is a mubtadaʾ, and the preposition «على بعض» is attached to the khabar; the clause «بعضكم على بعض» is a badal (substitute) of the clause «هم طوافون». The kāf in «كذلك» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, the implied sense being: يبين الله تبيينا مثل ذلك التبيين (Allah makes clear with a clarifying like that clarifying). The clause «يبين» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «والله عليم حكيم».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «بلغ» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and the lām is for the command. The kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), the implied sense being: استئذانا مثل استئذان (asking leave like the asking leave of…). The kāf in «كذلك» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. يبيِّن تبيينا مثل ذلك التبيين (He makes clear with a clarifying like that clarifying). The clause «يبين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The wāw in «والقواعد» is a conjunction, and «القواعد» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition «من النساء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «النساء» [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably «القواعد» is meant]. «اللاتي» is a naʿt (adjective). The fāʾ in «فليس» is redundant (zāʾida), and the clause «فليس جناح» is the khabar (predicate). The interpreted maṣdar «أن يضعن» is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). «غير» is a ḥāl of the nūn in «يضعن», and the prepositional phrase is attached to «متبرجات». The maṣdar «وأن يستعففن» is a mubtadaʾ, and its khabar is «خير»; the clause «والاستعفاف خير» is conjoined to the clause «القواعد ليس عليهن جناح». The preposition «لهن» is attached to «خير». The clause «والله سميع عليم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The preposition «على الأعرج» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «على الأعمى» and attached to (mutaʿalliq) what that is attached to, and the second «حرج» is conjoined to the preceding one. As for «ولا على أنفسكم أن تأكلوا»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is negating, and the prepositional phrase is conjoined to «على المريض» and attached to what that is attached to; «أن» is the particle that puts the verb in the subjunctive, and the maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. ولا على أنفسكم حرج في أن تأكلوا (nor is there blame on yourselves in eating). «أو ما ملكتم»: a relative noun, genitive, conjoined to «خالاتكم». «أو صديقكم»: a noun conjoined to «ما», genitive. The clause «ليس عليكم جناح» is resumptive, and the maṣdar «أن تأكلوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في); «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw. The conditional clause is resumptive; «إذا» is an adverbial conditional particle (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya) attached to the sense of the apodosis. «تحية» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), being synonymous with its governor; the prepositional phrase is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «تحية». The clause «يبيِّن» is resumptive, and the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq. The clause «لعلكم تعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: «إنما» is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). The conditional clause is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين». «معه» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the preposition «على أمر» is attached to the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. The clause «أولئك الذين» is the khabar of «إنَّ». The conditional clause «فإذا استأذنوك» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «إن الذين..».

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «بينكم»: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar «دعاء». The preposition «كدعاء» is attached to the second object of «جعل»; «بعضا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar «دعاء». The clause «قد يعلم الله» is resumptive; the preposition «منكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يتسللون». «لواذا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is synonymous with its verb. The clause «فليحذر» is resumptive, and the maṣdar «أن تصيبهم» is a mafʿūl bihi of «يحذر».

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «ألا» is an opening particle (ḥarf istiftāḥ), and the clause after it is resumptive. The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «قد يعلم» is resumptive. «ويوم يرجعون»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «ما», as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «فينبئهم» is conjoined to the clause «يرجعون»; «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar is attached to the verb. The clause «والله بكل شيء عليم» is resumptive, and the preposition «بكل» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «عليم».

mekki-muskil:1-1.t:
His saying, the Exalted, {سُورَة أنزلناها}: سورة is made nominative by an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "this is a sūra" (هَذِه سُورَة), and أنزلناها is a description (ṣifa) of سورة. An implied mubtadaʾ was needed, and سورة was not made nominative as a mubtadaʾ itself, only because it is indefinite, and one does not begin with an indefinite noun unless it is qualified; and if you make {أنزلناها} an adjective (naʿt), there would be no khabar (predicate) for it in the speech, because the adjective of a mubtadaʾ cannot be its khabar. So there was no avoiding implying a mubtadaʾ so that the qualification of السورة by أنزلناها would be sound.
ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar read سُورَةً أنزلناها in the accusative, by an implied verb which أنزلناها explains, its implied form being "We sent down a sūra — We sent it down" (أنزلنَا سُورَة أنزلناها). On this reading أنزلناها may not be a description of سورة, because a description does not explain what governs the described noun, just as the ṣila does not explain what governs the described [Translator's note: so in the source; the sense requires "the relative (mawṣūl)"]. It is also said that the accusative is on the implied form "recite a sūra which We have sent down" (اتل سُورَة أنزلناها); on this interpretation it is good for أنزلناها to be an adjective of السورة, because it does not explain the governor of السورة.

mekki-muskil:11-11.t: His saying {إِن الَّذين جاؤوا بالإفك عصبَة}: عصبة is the khabar of إن. It is permissible to read it in the accusative, and then the khabar is {لكل امْرِئ مِنْهُم}.

mekki-muskil:17-17.t: His saying {أَن تعودوا}: أن is in the position of the accusative by the omission of the preposition, its implied form being "so that you do not return" (لئلا تعودوا) or "out of aversion to your returning" (كَرَاهَة أَن تعودوا); so it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

mekki-muskil:2-2.t:
His saying {الزَّانِيَة وَالزَّانِي فاجلدوا كل وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا}: the preferred reading according to Sībawayh is the nominative, because by that two specific individuals are not intended. So the nominative, according to Sībawayh, is as a mubtadaʾ (subject) on the assumption of an omitted khabar (predicate), its implied form being "among what has been made obligatory upon you is [the case of] the fornicatress and the fornicator; so flog…" (فِيمَا فرض عَلَيْكُم الزَّانِيَة وَالزَّانِي فاجلدوا). It is also said that the khabar is what follows it, namely فاجلدوا, as you say زيد فاضربه ("Zayd — strike him"), as though the fāʾ were redundant (zāʾida).
It has been read بأربعةٍ شهداءَ, and this is irregular (shādhdh); شهداء would then be a naʿt (adjective) of أربعة, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from an indefinite noun.

mekki-muskil:25-25.t: His saying {دينهم الْحق}: Mujāhid read الحق in the nominative, making it a naʿt (adjective) of Allah (exalted be His mention); and the accusative is as a naʿt of الدين.

mekki-muskil:30-30.t: His saying {يغضوا من أَبْصَارهم}: مِن is for clarifying the genus (bayān al-jins), and is not partitive.

mekki-muskil:31-31.t: His saying غير أولي الإربة: whoever reads غير in the accusative makes it accusative as an exception or as a ḥāl (circumstantial). Whoever reads it in the genitive makes it a naʿt (adjective), because التابعين is not a genuinely definite noun with a specific referent, since it is not something known [to the hearer]. It may also be in the genitive as a badal (substitute). In both views it is like {غير المغضوب عَلَيْهِم}.

mekki-muskil:33-33.t: His saying {وَالَّذين يَبْتَغُونَ الْكتاب}: الَّذين is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "and among what is recited to you are those who seek the contract" (وَفِيمَا يُتْلَى عَلَيْكُم الَّذين يَبْتَغُونَ الْكتاب). They may also be in the position of the accusative by an implied verb, its implied form being "make a contract with those who seek the contract" (كاتبوا الَّذين يَبْتَغُونَ الْكتاب).

mekki-muskil:35-35.t:
His saying {مثل نوره كمشكاة}: مثل is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the kāf is the khabar (predicate). The hāʾ in نوره refers back to Allah (exalted be His mention); and it is said: to the Prophet (peace be upon him); and it is said: to faith in the heart of the believer.
His saying {دري}: whoever reads it with ḍamma on the dāl and a doubled yāʾ relates it to الدُّرّ (pearls) because of the excellence of its qualities, so it is فُعْلِيّ (a relative adjective). Its pattern may also be فُعِّيل, not a relative adjective, but derived from الدرء (repelling), with the hamza lightened so that it turned into a yāʾ, and the yāʾ before it was assimilated into it. As for whoever reads it with kasra on the dāl and with hamza (دِرِّيء), he makes it فِعِّيل from الدرء, on the pattern of فسيق and سكير; its meaning is that it drives away the darkness by its glittering and its light, so it is from درأت النجوم تدرأ, when the stars rush forth. As for whoever reads it with ḍamma on the dāl and with hamza (دُرِّيء), he makes it likewise فُعِّيل from درأت النجوم when they rush forth; and it is an adjective with few parallels: its parallel among nouns is المُرِّيق, and like it among adjectives are العُلِّيّة and السُّرِّيّة.

mekki-muskil:36-36.t: His saying {وَالْآصَال}: it is the plural of أُصُل, and أُصُل is the plural of أصيل, like رغيف and رُغُف. It is also said that the plural of الأصيل is أصائل; and it is said that أصائل is the plural of آصال.

mekki-muskil:4-4.t: His saying {فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جلدَة}: ثمانين is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), and جلدة as an explanation (tafsīr, i.e. tamyīz (specification)); and likewise the accusative of {مائَة جلدَة}.

mekki-muskil:40-40.t:
His saying {ظلمات}: whoever reads it in the nominative takes it as a mubtadaʾ (subject) with the khabar (predicate) من فوقه, or by an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. "they are darknesses" or "these are darknesses". Whoever reads it in the genitive makes it a badal (substitute) from the first ظلمات, and السحاب is nominative as a mubtadaʾ and من فوقه is the khabar.
His saying {لَا تحسبن الَّذين كفرُوا معجزين}: whoever reads it with yāʾ implies the agent, who is the Prophet (upon him be blessing and peace), and الذين and معجزين are the two objects of حسب. It is also possible that الذين are the agents, and you imply the first object of حسب, with معجزين the second; the implied form being "let not those who disbelieve think themselves able to escape" (لَا يَحسبن الَّذين كفرُوا أنفسهم معجزين). Whoever reads it with tāʾ, the Prophet (peace be upon him) is the agent, and {الَّذين} and {معجزين} are the two objects of حسب.

mekki-muskil:41-41.t: His saying {كل قد علم صلَاته}: كلا is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and in علم is the pronoun of Allah (exalted be His mention). On this view it is permissible to make كل accusative by an implied verb which what follows it explains, its implied form being "Allah knows each one — He knows its prayer" (علم الله كلا علم صلَاته). If you make the pronoun in علم refer to كل, the accusative of كل becomes remote, because it is an agent whose action falls on something connected with it; so if you make it accusative by an implied verb, you make its action pass to itself. There is disagreement on this question, and there is room for consideration in it, because the agent has made its action pass to itself, and that is only permitted with verbs that enter upon the mubtadaʾ and khabar, like ظننت and علمت. This is the school of Sībawayh; so the accusative in كل, while it is the agent, is not permissible according to him, but is permissible according to the Kufans.

mekki-muskil:43-43.t:
His saying {وَينزل من السَّمَاء من جبال فِيهَا من برد}: the second مِن is redundant (zāʾida) and the third مِن is for clarification (bayān); the implied form is "and He sends down from the sky mountains in it of hail" (وَينزل من السَّمَاء جبالا فِيهَا من برد), i.e. mountains of this kind. Al-Farrāʾ said: the implied form is "and He sends down from the sky, of mountains of hail" (وَينزل من السَّمَاء من جبال برد); so من برد according to al-Farrāʾ's view is in the position of the genitive, and according to the view of the Basrans in the position of the accusative as clarification or as a ḥāl (circumstantial). It has also been said that the third مِن is redundant and the implied form is "and He sends down from the sky, from mountains in it, hail" (وَينزل من السَّمَاء من جبال فِيهَا برد), i.e. He sends down hail from mountains in the sky. This indicates that in the sky there are mountains from which hail descends; while according to the first view it indicates that in the sky there are mountains of hail.
His saying {يذهب بالأبصار}: Abū Jaʿfar read it with ḍamma on the yāʾ of يُذهِب. This requires that the bāʾ not be brought, because it is a four-letter verb from أذهب, and the hamza alternates with the bāʾ [as a means of transitivity]. But al-Mubarrad and others permitted it on the basis that the bāʾ is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun), because the verb indicates it [Translator's note: the source reads يدل على اذ منه أخذ, evidently "indicates it, since it is taken from it"], its implied form being "it takes away, its taking away being with the sight" (يذهب ذَهَابه بالأبصار). On this basis they permitted أُدخِل بزيد السجن, as though he said "the prison was entered, an entering with Zayd" (أدخل السجن دخولا بزيد).

mekki-muskil:5-5.t: His saying إِلَّا الَّذين تَابُوا: الَّذين is in the position of the accusative as an exception; or, if you wish, in the position of the genitive as a badal (substitute) from the pronoun in لهم.

mekki-muskil:52-52.t: His saying {ويتقه}: whoever makes the qāf quiescent does so for lightness, as they said كَتْف for كَتِف. Whoever gives it kasra does so according to the origin, because the yāʾ after the qāf was dropped for the jussive.

mekki-muskil:53-53.t: His saying {طَاعَة}: nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "obedience is more fitting for you" (طَاعَة أولى بكم); or by an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. "our matter is obedience" (أمرنا طَاعَة). The accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun) is permissible.

mekki-muskil:55-55.t:
His saying {وعد الله الَّذين آمنُوا}: the basic usage of وعد is that it takes two objects, and you may restrict it to one of them; for that reason it takes one object in this verse, and the promise is explained by His saying {ليَستَخْلِفنهم}, as the promise in al-Māʾida is explained by His saying {لَهُم مغْفرَة}, and as the injunction in al-Nisāʾ is explained by His saying {للذّكر مثل حَظّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ}.
His saying {يعبدونني}: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from {الَّذين آمنُوا}, or in the position of the nominative as a break (qaṭʿ, a new sentence).

mekki-muskil:58-58.t:
His saying {ثَلَاث عورات}: whoever reads ثلاث in the accusative makes it a badal (substitute) from His saying {ثَلَاث مَرَّات}. {ثَلَاث مَرَّات} is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun); and it is said: because it is in the position of the maṣdar, not being a maṣdar in reality. It is also said that it is an adverb (ẓarf), its implied form being "three times", i.e. let them ask your permission at three times. This is more correct in meaning, because they were not commanded that slaves and children ask their permission three times; they were only commanded that they ask their permission at three times. Do you not see that He has explained the times, saying {من قبل صَلَاة الْفجْر وَحين تضعون ثيابكم من الظهيرة وَمن بعد صَلَاة الْعشَاء}? So He explained the three occasions by the times, and it is known that it is an adverb; and this is correct. So if it is an adverb, {ثَلَاث عورات} is substituted from it on the reading of whoever reads ثلاث عورات in the accusative. This substitution is not sound unless an omitted muḍāf is assumed, its implied form being "the times of three [periods of] privacy" (أَوْقَات ثَلَاث عورات); so you substitute "the times of three privacies" from "three times", and both are adverbs, so you substitute an adverb from an adverb, and the meaning and the i'rab are sound.
As for whoever reads ثلاث عورات in the nominative, he makes it the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "these are three privacies" (هَذِه ثَلَاث عورات), i.e. these are the times of three privacies; then the muḍāf was omitted by way of extension (ittisāʿ), and هذه points to the three times mentioned before this. But the speech was extended and the times were made "privacies", because the exposure of the private parts happens in them. It is like their saying نهارك صَائِم وليلك قَائِم ("your day is fasting and your night is standing in prayer"): you predicate fasting of the day because it happens in it, and standing of the night because it happens in it. From it is His saying, the Exalted, بل مكر اللَّيْل وَالنَّهَار: plotting is annexed [Translator's note: the source has أضبف for أضيف] to the night and the day, though they do not plot; but plotting happens in them on the part of those who do it, so the plotting was annexed to them by extension. Likewise you predicate "privacies" of the times, because in them [people's private parts] are exposed. For that reason Allah commanded His servants that no slave or child should enter upon them at these three times except after asking permission.
The original vowel of the wāw in العورات is fatḥa, but it was made quiescent so that the change [into alif] would not become necessary in it because it is vowelled and the letter before it has fatḥa; and like it is بيضات. This command from Allah to the believers was only because the houses were without doors.

mekki-muskil:6-6.t:
His saying {إِلَّا أنفسهم}: nominative as a badal (substitute) from شهداء, which is the noun of كان, and {وَلَهُم} is the khabar. It is permissible to make شهداء accusative as the fronted khabar of كان, with {أنفسهم} its noun; and it is permissible to make أنفسهم accusative as an exception or as the khabar of كان, but it has not been read so.
His saying {فشهادة أحدهم أَربع شَهَادَات}: أربع is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), and its governing word (ʿāmil) is شهادة. شهادة is nominative by an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "so the ruling" or "so the obligation is the testimony of one of them four times" (فَالْحكم أو فالفرض شَهَادَة أحدهم أَربع مَرَّات), i.e. the ruling is that one of them testify four testimonies by Allah that he is of the truthful. It is also said that شهادة is nominative as a mubtadaʾ with the khabar (predicate) omitted, i.e. "so it is upon them" or "so it is binding on them that one of them testify four testimonies".
His saying {إِنَّه لمن الصَّادِقين}: in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of شهادة. إنّ was not given fatḥa because of the lām that is in the khabar, as in your saying علمت إن زيدا لمنطلق ("I knew that Zayd is surely departing").
And His saying {بِاللَّه}: attached to (mutaʿalliq) شهادات, so it is in its ṣila, if you make the second govern; and if you assume the governing of the first, which is شهادة, the bāʾ is attached to شهادة. Whoever reads أربع in the nominative takes it as the khabar of شهادة, as you say صَلَاة الظّهْر أَربع رَكْعَات ("the noon prayer is four rakʿas"), and بالله is then attached to شهادات; it may not be attached to شهادة, because you would be separating the ṣila from the mawṣūl (relative) by the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, which is أربع شهادات. And إنه لمن الصادقين is then attached to شهادات, and is not attached to شهادة, because of what we mentioned of separating the ṣila from the mawṣūl.

mekki-muskil:60-60.t:
His saying {وَالْقَوَاعِد}: it is the plural of قاعد in the relational sense (ʿalā al-nasab), i.e. one possessing sitting [i.e. past childbearing]; for that reason the hāʾ [of the feminine] was dropped. The Kufans said: since it applies only to the feminine, the hāʾ was dispensed with. It is also said that the hāʾ was dropped to distinguish between it and القاعدة in the meaning of "the one seated".
His saying {غير متبرجات}: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent pronoun in يضعن; and it is said to be a ḥāl from هنّ in ثيابهن.
His saying {وَأَن يستعففن}: أن is in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and {خير} is the khabar (predicate).

mekki-muskil:61-61.t:
His saying {جَمِيعًا أَو أشتاتا}: both are ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent pronoun in تأكلوا.
His saying {تَحِيَّة}: a maṣdar (verbal noun), because {فَسَلمُوا} means "then greet".

mekki-muskil:63-63.t:
His saying {كدعاء بَعْضكُم}: the kāf is in the position of the accusative as the second object of جعل.
His saying {لِوَاذًا}: a maṣdar (verbal noun); and it is said to be a ḥāl (circumstantial) in the meaning of "taking cover with one another" (ملاوذين). لواذا remained sound with the wāw because it is sound in لاوذ, and the maṣdar of فاعَل does not undergo weakening (iʿlāl).

mekki-muskil:7-7.t: His saying {وَالْخَامِسَة}: nominative, conjoined to أربع in the reading of whoever reads it in the nominative, or as a break (qaṭʿ, a new sentence).

mekki-muskil:8-8.t: His saying {أَن تشهد أَربع شَهَادَات}: nothing is good in أربع but the accusative by تشهد. أن is in the position of the nominative by يدرأ [as its agent], its implied form being "and her testifying four testimonies by Allah that he is of the liars averts the punishment from her" (وَيدْفَع عَنْهَا الْحَد شهادتها أَربع شَهَادَات بِاللَّه إنه لمن الْكَاذِبين). إنه and what follows it is in the position of the accusative by تشهد, and إنّ was given kasra because of the lām that is in the khabar [Translator's note: the source has الخير, evidently for الخبر]. And in بالله the bāʾ may well be attached to the first or the second.

mekki-muskil:9-9.t:
His saying {وَالْخَامِسَة}, which is the second one: whoever reads it in the accusative conjoins it to أربع شهادات, or [takes it] by an implied verb, its implied form being "and she testifies the fifth" (وَتشهد الْخَامِسَة). It is put in the place of the maṣdar (verbal noun), and its origin is an adjective set up in place of the qualified noun, as though He said "and she testifies the fifth testimony" (وَتشهد الشَّهَادَة الْخَامِسَة); then it was omitted [Translator's note: the source reads حذف الوجهين, "omitted the two aspects", as written]. Whoever reads it in the nominative takes it as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
His saying {أَن لعنة الله} and {أَن غضب الله}: أن and what follows it are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of الخامسة, if you make it nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or in the position of the accusative by the omission of the preposition, if you read {وَالْخَامِسَة} in the accusative. And الخامسة is an adjective standing in place of the qualified noun in the nominative, the implied form being "and the fifth testimony is that the curse of Allah be upon him" and "that the wrath of Allah be upon her". The bāʾ may not be attached to the omitted الشهادة, because you would be separating the ṣila from the mawṣūl by the description, and that is not permissible.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿سورة أنزلناها وفرضناها وأنزلنا فيها آيات بينات﴾: (سورة) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: this is a sūra (هذه سورة); or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e.: among what We have revealed to you is a sūra (فيما أوحينا إليك سورة); beginning with an indefinite noun is permissible because it is described by the clause (أنزلناها); ﴿وفرضناها﴾ is conjoined to (أنزلناها); ﴿وأنزلنا﴾ is conjoined as well; (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلنا﴾; (آيات) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (بينات) is an adjective (naʿt) of (آيات).
﴿لعلكم تذكرون﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; the clause (تذكرون) is its khabar; and the clause ﴿لعلكم تذكرون﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿الزانية والزاني فاجلدوا كل واحد منهما مائة جلدة﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; (الزانية) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted; (الزاني) is conjoined to (الزانية); the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "disclosing" fāʾ); ﴿اجلدوا﴾ is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿كل﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿واحد﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿منهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (naʿt) of ﴿كل﴾; ﴿مائة﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): it has taken the place of the maṣdar (verbal noun) because it is its number. And (جلدة) is the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ولا تأخذكم بهما رأفة في دين الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is the lā of prohibition; (تأخذكم) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنتم) [Translator's note: so in the source; it goes on to give (رأفة) as the fāʿil, and the verb (تأخذ) is third-person feminine, so the remark about a latent "you" appears to be a slip — "you" (كم) is the object]; ﴿بهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأخذكم﴾; (رأفة) is the fāʿil; and ﴿في دين الله﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تأخذكم﴾ as well.
﴿إن كنتم تؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: (إن) is conditional; (كنتم) is a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters), and the tāʾ is its noun; ﴿كنتم﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause ﴿تؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر﴾ is the khabar of (كنتم); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.
﴿وليشهد عذابهما طائفة من المؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; (يشهد) is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the lām; (عذابهما) is a direct object placed first; (طائفة) is a fāʿil placed after; and (من المؤمنين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of (طائفة).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿الزاني لا ينكح إلا زانية أو مشركة﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; (الزاني) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿لا ينكح﴾ is the khabar (predicate); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (زانية) is the object; (أو) is a conjunction; and (مشركة) is maʿṭūf (conjoined).
﴿والزانية لا ينكحها إلا زان أو مشرك﴾: a clause conjoined to the one before it; the wāw is a conjunction; (الزانية) is maʿṭūf; (لا) is negative; (ينكحها) is a verb and an object placed first; (إلا) is a particle of restriction; (زان) is the fāʿil (agent); (أو) is a conjunction; and (مشرك) is maʿṭūf.
﴿وحرم ذلك على المؤمنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (حرم) is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and (ذلك) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿على المؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حرم﴾; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿والذين يرمون المحصنات ثم لم يأتوا بأربعة شهداء﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الذين) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (يرمون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position; (المحصنات) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ثم لم يأتوا﴾ is conjoined to (يرمون); (بأربعة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأتوا﴾; and (شهداء) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the genitive with the fatḥa because it is a diptote, owing to the feminine alif in it.
﴿فاجلدوهم ثمانين جلدة ولا تقبلوا لهم شهادة أبدا وأولئك هم الفاسقون﴾: the fāʾ links the answer of the relative noun, which carries the meaning of a condition; ﴿اجلدوهم﴾ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its direct object; the clause ﴿فاجلدوهم﴾ is a first khabar (predicate) of ﴿الذين﴾; (ثمانين) stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): it has taken the place of the maṣdar (verbal noun) because it is its number; and (جلدة) is a tamyīz (specification). The clause ﴿والذين يرمون المحصنات...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿ولا تقبلوا﴾ is conjoined to (فاجلدوهم), and it is in effect a second khabar of (الذين); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective (naʿt) of (شهادة); ﴿أبدًا﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿تقبلوا﴾; (وأولئك): the wāw is a conjunction, (أولئك) is a mubtadaʾ, (هم) is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and (الفاسقون) is the khabar of (أولئك); and the clause is in effect a third khabar of (الذين).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿إلا الذين تابوا من بعد ذلك وأصلحوا فإن الله غفور رحيم﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; (الذين) is excepted from ﴿الفاسقين﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the previous ayah reads (الفاسقون)]; the clause (تابوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position; ﴿من بعد ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تابوا﴾; (أصلحوا) is conjoined to (تابوا); (فإن): the fāʾ gives the reason for what preceded; (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; (غفور) is its first khabar (predicate), and (رحيم) is its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿والذين يرمون أزواجهم ولم يكن لهم شهداء إلا أنفسهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (الذين) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يرمون أزواجهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; what ﴿يرمون﴾ is attached to is omitted, i.e.: with adultery (بالزنى); (ولم): the wāw is a wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial) or a conjunction; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion (to past meaning) and jussive; (يكن) is a defective imperfect verb (of kāna and its sisters) in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (شهداء) is its noun placed after; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and (أنفسهم) is a badal (substitute) for (شهداء).
﴿فشهادة أحدهم أربع شهادات بالله إنه لمن الصادقين﴾: the fāʾ is connective (ṣila); (شهادة) is a mubtadaʾ, and (أحدهم) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿أربع شهادات﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (بالله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (شهادات); (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun; the hamza of (إن) takes the kasra because of the presence of the lām; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿من الصادقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of (إن); (إن) and what follows it are the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (شهادات); and the clause ﴿فشهادة أحدهم﴾ is the khabar of (الذين).

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿والخامسة أن لعنة الله عليه إن كان من الكاذبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (الخامسة) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (أن) and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the khabar (predicate); (لعنة) is the noun of (أن); the Name of Majesty is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of (أن); (إن) is conditional; (كان) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir); ﴿من الكاذبين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of (كان); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; and the clause ﴿الخامسة أن لعنة الله عليه...﴾ is conjoined to ﴿شهادة أحدهم أربع﴾.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿ويدرأ عنها العذاب أن تشهد أربع شهادات بالله إنه لمن الكاذبين﴾: the clause (ويدرأ) is conjoined to what preceded; (يدرأ) is an imperfect verb; (عنها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; (العذاب) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أن تشهد﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the fāʿil (agent) of (يدرأ); ﴿أربع شهادات﴾ is accusative as a maṣdar, so it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): it has taken the place of the maṣdar because it is its number; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (شهادات), or to (أن تشهد); ﴿إنه لمن الكاذبين﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ﴿من الكاذبين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of (إن).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿والخامسة أن غضب الله عليها إن كان من الصادقين﴾: (الخامسة) is conjoined to (أربع), in the accusative; ﴿أن غضب الله عليها﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is a badal (substitute); (إن) is conditional; (كان) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir); ﴿من الصادقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (كان); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته وأن الله تواب حكيم﴾: (لولا) is a particle of impossibility due to existence; ﴿فضل الله﴾: (فضل) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the Name of Majesty is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the khabar (predicate) is obligatorily omitted; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فضل); (رحمته) is conjoined to (فضل); ﴿أن الله تواب﴾: (أن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and (تواب) is its khabar, and it is conjoined to (فضل); and the answer of (لولا) is omitted.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿إن الذين جاءوا بالإفك عصبة منكم﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); (الذين) is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of (إن); the clause (جاءوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position; (بالإفك) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءوا﴾; (عصبة) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); and (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt) of (عصبة).
﴿لا تحسبوه شرا لكم بل هو خير لكم﴾: the clause (لا تحسبوه) is resumptive with no grammatical position; (لا) is jussive-governing; (تحسبوه) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and (شرًّا) is the second object; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شرًا﴾; (بل) is a particle of conjunction and of turning away (iḍrāb); ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (خير) is the khabar; and ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خير).
﴿لكل امرئ منهم ما اكتسب من الإثم﴾: ﴿لكل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first; (امرئ) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿امرئ﴾; (ما) is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ placed after; the clause (اكتسب) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; and (من الإثم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اكتسب﴾.
﴿والذي تولى كبره منهم له عذاب عظيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الذي) is a mubtadaʾ; the clause (تولى كبره) is the ṣila of (الذي) and has no grammatical position; (منهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿له﴾ is a khabar placed first; ﴿عذاب﴾ is a mubtadaʾ placed after; (عظيم) is an adjective of (عذاب); the clause is the khabar of (الذي); and the clause ﴿والذي تولى...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿لولا إذ سمعتموه ظن المؤمنون والمؤمنات بأنفسهم خيرا﴾: (لولا) is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) carrying the meaning of rebuke and reproach; (إذ) is an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ظن﴾; the clause ﴿سمعتموه﴾ is in the position of the genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; ﴿ظن المؤمنون﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (المؤمنات) is conjoined; (بأنفسهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خيرًا﴾; and (خيرًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وقالوا هذا إفك مبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قالوا) is conjoined to (ظن); (هذا) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (إفك) is the khabar (predicate); (مبين) is an adjective (naʿt); and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿لولا جاءوا عليه بأربعة شهداء فإذ لم يأتوا بالشهداء﴾: (لولا) is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); (جاءوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (شهداء); (بأربعة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاءوا﴾; and (شهداء) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فإذ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إذ) is an adverb for past time, attached to ﴿الكاذبون﴾; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion (to past meaning) and jussive; (يأتوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم), and the clause is in the position of the genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; (بالشهداء) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتوا﴾.
﴿فأولئك عند الله هم الكاذبون﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ; (أولئك) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (عند الله) is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿هم﴾ is a second mubtadaʾ, or a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl); (الكاذبون) is the khabar (predicate) of (أولئك) or the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause is the khabar of (أولئك).

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته في الدنيا والآخرة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لولا) is a particle of impossibility due to existence; ﴿فضل الله﴾: (فضل) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the Name of Majesty is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the khabar (predicate) is obligatorily omitted; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فضل); (رحمته) is conjoined to (فضل); ﴿في الدنيا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and (الآخرة) is conjoined to (الدنيا).
﴿لمسكم في ما أفضتم فيه عذاب عظيم﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of (لولا); (مسكم) is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; ﴿في ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مسكم﴾; the clause (أفضتم فيه) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; it has also been said that (ما) is maṣdar-forming, i.e.: would have touched you because of your pouring forth and plunging into the slander. ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أفضتم﴾; (عذاب) is the fāʿil (agent), and (عظيم) is an adjective (naʿt).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿إذ تلقونه بألسنتكم وتقولون بأفواهكم ما ليس لكم به علم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مسكم﴾ or to ﴿أفضتم﴾; (تلقونه) is an imperfect verb from which one of its two tāʾs has been dropped; it is nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of the genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; (بألسنتكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تلقونه﴾; ﴿تقولون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تلقونه﴾; (بأفواهكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تقولون﴾; (ما) is the object of (تقولون); the clause ﴿ليس﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position; (ليس) is a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (علم); and (علم) is the noun of (ليس), placed after.
﴿وتحسبونه هينا وهو عند الله عظيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (تحسبونه) is an imperfect verb, its agent and its first object; (هينًا) is the second object; the wāw is for the ḥāl (circumstantial); (هو) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عند الله﴾ is an accusative adverb attached to the khabar ﴿عظيم﴾, and the Name of Majesty is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (عظيم) is the khabar of (هو); and the clause is a ḥāl clause.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿ولولا إذ سمعتموه قلتم ما يكون لنا أن نتكلم بهذا﴾: (لولا) is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) and reproach; (إذ) is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قلتم﴾; the clause (سمعتموه) is in the position of the genitive as the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause (قلتم) has no grammatical position because it is an initial (ibtidāʾiyya) clause; (ما) is negative; (يكون) is a defective imperfect verb (of kāna and its sisters); ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (أن) and what falls within its scope are its noun placed after; and (بهذا) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نتكلم﴾.
﴿سبحانك هذا بهتان عظيم﴾: (هذا) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), (بهتان) is the khabar, and (عظيم) is an adjective (naʿt); (سبحانك) stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb, and the kāf is the muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿يعظكم الله أن تعودوا لمثله أبدا إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: (يعظكم) is an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); (أن) and what falls within its scope are accusative by removal of the preposition, because (the verb) has been made to carry the meaning of a verb that is transitive by means of ﴿عن﴾; (لمثله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تعودوا﴾; (أبدًا) is an adverb of time, also attached to ﴿تعودوا﴾. It has also been said that there is no such implied meaning (taḍmīn) in (يعظكم), and that (أن) and what follows it are a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) with an omitted muḍāf, i.e.: in aversion to your returning (كراهة أن تعودوا). (إن) is conditional; (كنتم): (كان) is a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ is its noun, and (مؤمنين) is its khabar (predicate); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: if you are believers, then do not return to the like of it.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t: ﴿ويبين الله لكم الآيات والله عليم حكيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿يبين الله﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبين﴾; (الآيات) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); and (عليم حكيم) are two khabars (predicates) of the Name of Majesty.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿إن الذين يحبون أن تشيع الفاحشة في الذين آمنوا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); (الذين) is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of (إن); the clause (يحبون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; (أن) and what falls within its scope are the object of (يحبون); (الفاحشة) is the fāʿil (agent); and ﴿في الذين آمنوا﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تشيع﴾.
﴿لهم عذاب أليم في الدنيا والآخرة والله يعلم وأنتم لا تعلمون﴾: (لهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (عذاب) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the nominal clause is the khabar of (إن); (أليم) is an adjective (naʿt); (في الدنيا والآخرة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second adjective; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause (يعلم) is the khabar; (أنتم) is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause (لا تعلمون) is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته وأن الله رءوف رحيم﴾: (لولا) is the particle of impossibility (imtināʿiyya); ﴿فضل الله عليكم﴾: (فضل) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is obligatorily omitted, and the Name of Majesty is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فضل); (رحمته) is conjoined to (فضل); ﴿أن الله رءوف رحيم﴾ is conjoined to (فضل); and the answer of (لولا) is omitted, i.e.: He would have hastened the punishment upon you.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تتبعوا خطوات الشيطان﴾: (لا) is the lā of prohibition; (تتبعوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لا); and (خطوات الشيطان) are the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ومن يتبع خطوات الشيطان فإنه يأمر بالفحشاء والمنكر﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (يتبع) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (خطوات الشيطان) are the direct object and the muḍāf ilayhi; the fāʾ links the apodosis, because it is a nominal clause; (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿يأمر بالفحشاء والمنكر﴾ is its khabar (predicate); and the pronoun in (إنه) refers to Satan, or to the one who follows.
﴿ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته ما زكى منكم من أحد أبدا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿لولا﴾ is a particle of impossibility due to existence, carrying the meaning of a condition; ﴿فضل الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being "exists" (موجود); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فضل); (رحمته) is conjoined to (فضل); (ما) is negative; (زكى) is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), referring to Allah; (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective (naʿt) of (أحد); (من) is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) particle; (أحد) is genitive in form and accusative in position as the mafʿūl bihi; and (أبدًا) is an adverb attached to ﴿زكى﴾.
﴿ولكن الله يزكي من يشاء والله سميع عليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لكن) is an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause (يزكي) is its khabar; ﴿من يشاء﴾ is the object of (يزكي), and the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ, (سميع) is a first khabar, and (عليم) is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ولا يأتل أولو الفضل منكم والسعة أن يؤتوا أولي القربى والمساكين والمهاجرين في سبيل الله﴾: (لا) is the lā of prohibition; (يأتل) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (أولو) is the fāʿil (agent), treated like (mulḥaq) the sound masculine plural; (الفضل) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (منكم) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); (السعة) is conjoined to (الفضل); (أن يؤتوا): (أن) and what falls within its scope are accusative by removal of the preposition, with the omission of the negative (لا), the implied form being: that they would not give (على ألا يؤتوا); ﴿أولي القربى﴾ are the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the muḍāf ilayhi, and what follows is conjoined to it.
﴿وليعفوا وليصفحوا ألا تحبون أن يغفر الله لكم والله غفور رحيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; (يعفوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the lām of command; (ليصفحوا) is conjoined; the hamza is interrogative; (لا) is negative; (تحبون) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); (أن) and what falls within its scope are the object of (تحبون); the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يغفر﴾; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (غفور) is a first khabar (predicate), and (رحيم) is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t: ﴿إن الذين يرمون المحصنات الغافلات المؤمنات لعنوا في الدنيا والآخرة ولهم عذاب عظيم﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and (الذين) is its noun; the clause ﴿يرمون المحصنات﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; the clause (لعنوا) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); ﴿في الدنيا والآخرة﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لعنوا﴾; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first; (عذاب) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; and (عظيم) is an adjective (naʿt).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿يوم تشهد عليهم ألسنتهم وأيديهم وأرجلهم بما كانوا يعملون﴾: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of settledness (al-istiqrār) to which ﴿ولهم﴾ is attached; it has also been said that it is attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun), namely (عذاب); the clause (تشهد) is in the position of the genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تشهد﴾; (ألسنتهم) is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿وأيديهم وأرجلهم﴾ are conjoined to (ألسنتهم); (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تشهد﴾; the clause (كانوا) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾; or (ما) is maṣdar-forming; (كان) is a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause (يعملون) is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿يومئذ يوفيهم الله دينهم الحق﴾: ﴿يومئذ﴾: (يوم) is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يوفيهم﴾, and (إذٍ) is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause; ﴿يوفيهم الله﴾ is an imperfect verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil (agent); ﴿دينهم﴾ is the second object; and ﴿الحق﴾ is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿دينهم﴾.
﴿ويعلمون أن الله هو الحق المبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿يعلمون﴾ is conjoined to (يوفيهم); ﴿أنّ﴾ and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of (يعلمون); the Name of Majesty is the noun of (أن); ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and ﴿الحق﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (أنّ); or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), ﴿الحق﴾ is the khabar of (هو), and the clause ﴿هو الحق﴾ is the khabar of (أنّ); and ﴿المبين﴾ is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿الخبيثات للخبيثين والخبيثون للخبيثات والطيبات للطيبين والطيبون للطيبات﴾: (الخبيثات) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (للخبيثين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); and what follows is conjoined to it.
﴿أولئك مبرءون مما يقولون لهم مغفرة ورزق كريم﴾: (أولئك) is a mubtadaʾ; (مبرءون) is the khabar of (أولئك); (مما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مبرءون﴾; the clause (يقولون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first; (مغفرة) is a mubtadaʾ placed after; the clause is a second khabar of (أولئك); and ﴿رزق كريم﴾ is conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تدخلوا بيوتا غير بيوتكم حتى تستأنسوا وتسلموا على أهلها﴾: (لا) is the lā of prohibition; (تدخلوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (بيوتًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa); (غير بيوتكم) is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿بيوتًا﴾; (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (تستأنسوا) is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after (حتى); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from (أن) and the verb is genitive by (حتى), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تدخلوا﴾; (تسلموا) is conjoined to (تستأنسوا); and (على أهلها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تسلموا﴾.
﴿ذلكم خير لكم لعلكم تذكرون﴾: (ذلكم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (خير) is the khabar (predicate); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خير); the clause (ذلكم) is resumptive with no grammatical position; (لعل) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; and the clause (تذكرون) is the khabar of (لعل).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿فإن لم تجدوا فيها أحدا فلا تدخلوها حتى يؤذن لكم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إن) is conditional; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion (to past meaning) and jussive; (تجدوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم); (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تجدوا﴾; (أحدًا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فلا تدخلوها﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) is the lā of prohibition; (تدخلوها) is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the prohibitive lā; (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (يؤذن) is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after (حتى); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from (أن) and the verb is genitive by (حتى), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تدخلوها﴾; ﴿يؤذن﴾ is built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); and ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤذن﴾.
﴿وإن قيل لكم ارجعوا فارجعوا هو أزكى لكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; ﴿قيل﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قيل﴾; the clause (ارجعوا) is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فارجعوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, because it is a request; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿أزكى لكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿والله بما تعملون عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿بما تعملون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عليم); (عليم) is the khabar of (الله); and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿ليس عليكم جناح أن تدخلوا بيوتا غير مسكونة فيها متاع لكم﴾: (ليس) is a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (ليس), placed first; (جناح) is its noun placed after; (أن) and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: in that you enter (في أن تدخلوا), and the preposition and its genitive noun are an adjective (naʿt) of (جناح); (بيوتًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa); (غير مسكونة) is an adjective of ﴿بيوتًا﴾; (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first; ﴿متاع﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of (متاع); and the clause is a second adjective of ﴿بيوتًا﴾.
﴿والله يعلم ما تبدون وما تكتمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause (يعلم) is the khabar; (ما) is the direct object; the clause (تبدون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; the clause ﴿والله يعلم...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; and ﴿وما تكتمون﴾ is conjoined to (ما تبدون).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿قل للمؤمنين يغضوا من أبصارهم ويحفظوا فروجهم﴾: ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿للمؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قل﴾; ﴿يغضوا﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by an implied (muqaddar) lām of command, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; omitting the lām is permissible because ﴿قُل﴾ indicates the command; and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil.
Or: ﴿يغضوا﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive as the answer to the command ﴿قُل﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) is omitted, and the implied form of the speech is: say to the believers, "Lower your gaze and guard your private parts" (غُضُّوا من أبصاركم واحفظوا فروجكم), [and] they will lower their gaze and guard their private parts.
Or: ﴿يغضوا﴾ is an imperfect verb diverted from command to statement, its meaning being ﴿غضوا﴾, and it is made indeclinable (mabnī) because it occupies the place of an indeclinable form, so its nūn is dropped.
﴿من أبصارهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغضوا﴾, and the attached pronoun is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿ويحفظوا﴾ is conjoined to (يغضوا); and ﴿فروجهم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ذلك أزكى لهم﴾: ﴿ذلك﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿أزكى﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أزكى﴾; and the nominal clause is resumptive and causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله خبير بما يصنعون﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is the noun of (إن); ﴿خبير﴾ is the khabar of (إن); ﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, i.e.: of what they do (بالذي يصنعونه); or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from ﴿ما يصنعون﴾ is genitive by the bāʾ, i.e.: of their doing (بصنعِهم); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿خبير﴾; the clause ﴿يصنعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿إن الله خبير...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; or the meaning may be: hoping for your success, in which case the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of (توبوا). [Translator's note: this last alternative ("hoping for your success … ḥāl of the agent of توبوا") does not fit this ayah; it belongs to (لعلكم تفلحون) after (وتوبوا) in the next ayah (24:31) and appears to have been carried over from there.]

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿وقل للمؤمنات يغضضن من أبصارهن ويحفظن فروجهن﴾: ﴿وقل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قل) is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿للمؤمنات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قل﴾; the clause ﴿قل للمؤمنات﴾ is conjoined to the preceding clause ﴿قل للمؤمنين﴾; ﴿يغضضن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) by an implied (muqaddar) lām of command; omitting the lām is permissible because ﴿قُل﴾ indicates the command; and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil.
Or: ﴿يغضضن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the jussive as the answer to the command ﴿قُل﴾, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the implied form is: and say to the believing women, "Lower your gaze, guard your private parts and do not display …" (اغضضْن من أبصاركن واحفظْن فروجكن ولا تبدين ...), [and] they will lower their gaze, guard their private parts and not display … (يغضضن من أبصارهن ويحفظن فروجهن ولا يبدين....).
Or: ﴿يغضضن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and it has been diverted from command to statement, its meaning being ﴿اغضضْن﴾.
﴿من أبصارهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغضضن﴾, and the attached pronoun is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿ويحفظن﴾ is conjoined to (يغضضن); and ﴿فروجهن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولا يبدين زينتهن إلا ما ظهر منها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of prohibition; ﴿يبدين﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on an implied sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the jussive by the prohibitive lā; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يبدين﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يغضضن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is in the jussive by an implied lām of command or stands in the place of a command meaning (اغضضْن), and it is conjoined to the implied object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) ﴿اغضضْن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is the answer to the command ﴿قل﴾.
﴿زينتهن﴾ is the direct object; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, a badal (substitute) for (زينتهن); and the clause ﴿ظهر منها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position.
﴿وليضربن بخمرهن على جيوبهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ليضربن﴾: the lām is the lām of command; (يضربن) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the jussive by the lām of command; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿ليضربن﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يغضضن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is in the jussive by an implied lām of command or stands in the place of a command meaning (اغضضْن), and it is conjoined to the implied object of the saying ﴿اغضضْن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is the answer to the command ﴿قُل﴾. ﴿بخمرهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضربن﴾, and ﴿على جيوبهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضربن﴾.
﴿ولا يبدين زينتهن إلا لبعولتهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the i'rab of ﴿لا يبدين﴾ is like the i'rab of the earlier ﴿لا يبدين﴾ in this ayah; ﴿زينتهن﴾ is the direct object; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction; and ﴿لبعولتهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبدين﴾.
﴿أو آبائهن أو آباء بعولتهن أو أبنائهن أو أبناء بعولتهن أو إخوانهن أو بني إخوانهن أو بني أخواتهن أو نسائهن أو ما ملكت أيمانهن﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿بعولتهن﴾.
﴿أو التابعين غير أولي الإربة من الرجال أو الطفل الذين لم يظهروا على عورات النساء﴾: ﴿أو التابعين﴾ is also conjoined to ﴿بعولتهن﴾; ﴿غير﴾ is an adjective (naʿt) of (التابعين); ﴿أولي﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿الإربة﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿من الرجال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿أو الطفل﴾ is also conjoined, and it means "children", so the ﴿أل﴾ is generic; ﴿الذين﴾ is an adjective; the clause ﴿لم يظهروا﴾ is the ṣila of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; ﴿على عورات النساء﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يظهروا﴾; and (النساء) is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ولا يضربن بأرجلهن ليعلم ما يخفين من زينتهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of prohibition; ﴿يضربن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the jussive by the prohibitive lā; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يضربن﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يغضضن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is in the jussive by an implied lām of command or stands in the place of a command meaning (اغضضْن), and it is conjoined to the implied object of the saying ﴿اغضضْن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is the answer to the command ﴿قل﴾. ﴿بأرجلهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضربن﴾; ﴿ليعلم﴾: the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl), and ﴿يعلم﴾ is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after the causal lām, and it is built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by the causal lām, and the lām and its genitive are attached to ﴿يضربن﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿يخفين﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يخفين﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun and has no grammatical position; the pronoun returning to ﴿ما﴾ is omitted, the implied form being: so that what they hide be known (ليعلم ما يخفينه); and ﴿من زينتهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the omitted returning pronoun, which is the object of (يخفين).
﴿وتوبوا إلى الله جميعا أيها المؤمنون لعلكم تفلحون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, or the wāw is a conjunction joining it to the clause ﴿قل للمؤمنين﴾; ﴿توبوا﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; ﴿إلى الله﴾: (إلى) is a preposition, the Name of Majesty is a noun in the genitive by (إلى), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿توبوا﴾; ﴿جميعًا﴾ is a ḥāl; ﴿أيها﴾: (أيُّ) is the one addressed in the vocative, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, ﴿ها﴾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and the vocative particle is omitted; ﴿المؤمنون﴾ is an adjective of ﴿أي﴾; ﴿لعلكم﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the pronoun of the addressees is in the position of the accusative as the noun of (لعل); the clause ﴿تفلحون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (لعل); and the clause ﴿لعلكم تفلحون﴾ is resumptive or causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿وأنكحوا الأيامى منكم والصالحين من عبادكم وإمائكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الأيامى) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿وأنكحوا الأيامى﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (الصالحين) is conjoined to (الأيامى); (من عبادكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and (إمائكم) is conjoined to (عبادكم).
﴿إن يكونوا فقراء يغنهم الله من فضله والله واسع عليم﴾: (إن) is conditional; (يكونوا) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is its noun, and (فقراء) is its khabar (predicate); (يغنهم الله) is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (من فضله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغنهم﴾; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (واسع) is a first khabar, and (عليم) is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿وليستعفف الذين لا يجدون نكاحا حتى يغنيهم الله من فضله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; (يستعفف) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; (الذين) is the fāʿil (agent); the clause (لا يجدون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; (نكاحًا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (يغنيهم) is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after (حتى); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from (أن) and the verb is genitive by (حتى), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستعفف﴾; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; and (من فضله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغنيهم﴾.
﴿والذين يبتغون الكتاب مما ملكت أيمانكم فكاتبوهم إن علمتم فيهم خيرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (الذين) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is the clause (فكاتبوهم); the clause (يبتغون الكتاب) is the ṣila of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause (ملكت أيمانكم) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; the fāʾ is a linking one because of the hint of condition in the relative noun; (كاتبوهم) is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and ﴿هم﴾ is the direct object; the clause is the khabar; (إن) is conditional; (علمتم) is a past verb and its fāʿil, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (فيهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿علمتم﴾; (خيرًا) is the direct object; and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by His words (فكاتبوهم).
﴿وآتوهم من مال الله الذي آتاكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (آتوهم) is conjoined to (فكاتبوهم); ﴿من مال الله﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿آتوهم﴾; (الذي) is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿لله﴾; and the clause (آتاكم) is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) and has no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تكرهوا فتياتكم على البغاء إن أردن تحصنا لتبتغوا عرض الحياة الدنيا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is the lā of prohibition; (تكرهوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the prohibitive lā; (على البغاء) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تكرهوا﴾; (إن) is conditional; (أردن) is a past verb and its fāʿil, in the position of the jussive as the protasis; (تحصنًا) is a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose) [Translator's note: so in the source; (تحصنًا) is more naturally the direct object of (أردن)]; the apodosis is omitted; ﴿لتبتغوا﴾: the lām is causal, (تبتغوا) is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after the causal lām, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and ﴿عرض الحياة الدنيا﴾ are the direct object and the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ومن يكرههن فإن الله من بعد إكراههن غفور رحيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ; (يكرههن) is the protasis; the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ, because the apodosis is a nominal clause; (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿من بعد إكراههن﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl; (غفور) is the first khabar of (إن), and (رحيم) is its second khabar; and the clause ﴿يكرهن﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿ولقد أنزلنا إليكم آيات مبينات ومثلا من الذين خلوا من قبلكم وموعظة للمتقين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (أنزلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (إليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلنا﴾; (آيات) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ولقد أنزلنا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; (مبينات) is an adjective (naʿt); (مثلًا) is conjoined to (آيات); ﴿من الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿مثلًا﴾; the clause (خلوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; ﴿من قبلكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (موعظة) is conjoined to ﴿مثلًا﴾; and ﴿للمتقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of (موعظة).

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿الله﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿نور﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿السماوات﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿والأرض﴾: conjoined to (السماوات).
﴿مثل﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿نوره﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿كمشكاة﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿مشكاة﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar placed first.
﴿مصباح﴾: a mubtadaʾ placed after. The clause ﴿فيها مصباح﴾ is an adjective (naʿt) of (مشكاة). The clause ﴿مثل نوره﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿المصباح﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿في زجاجة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar. The clause ﴿المصباح في زجاجة﴾ is in the position of the nominative as an adjective of ﴿مصباح﴾.
﴿الزجاجة﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿كأنها﴾: (كأن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and ﴿ها﴾ is its noun.
﴿كوكب﴾: its khabar.
﴿دري﴾: an adjective of (كوكب). The clause ﴿كأنها كوكب﴾ is the khabar of (الزجاجة). The clause ﴿الزجاجة كأنها...﴾ is in the position of the genitive as an adjective of ﴿زجاجة﴾.
﴿يوقد﴾: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). The clause ﴿يوقد﴾ is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar of ﴿مصباح﴾, or in the position of the nominative as an adjective of ﴿مصباح﴾.
﴿من شجرة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يوقد﴾.
﴿مباركة﴾: an adjective of (شجرة).
﴿زيتونة﴾: a badal (substitute) for ﴿شجرة﴾; it has also been said: an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it.
﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿شرقية﴾: a second adjective of ﴿شجرة﴾, or an adjective of ﴿زيتونة﴾. ﴿لا﴾ has entered upon the adjective to convey negation.
﴿ولا غربية﴾: conjoined to ﴿شرقية﴾.
﴿يكاد﴾: a defective imperfect verb, one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba).
﴿زيتها﴾: the noun of ﴿يكاد﴾, and ﴿ها﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿يضيء﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent. The clause ﴿يضيء﴾ is the khabar of ﴿يكاد﴾.
﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is a wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial). (لو) is a non-jussive conditional particle.
﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, conversion (to past meaning) and jussive.
﴿تمسسه﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾. The answer of (لو) is omitted because what precedes indicates it, the implied form being: it would have shone (لأضاء); and the clause ﴿لو لم تمسسه نار﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the agent of ﴿يضيء﴾.
﴿نار﴾: the fāʿil of ﴿تمسسه﴾.
﴿نور﴾: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: this to which the truth has been likened is a multiplied light (هذا الذي شبهت به الحق نور متضاعف).
﴿على نور﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿نور﴾ that emphasises it. The clause ﴿نور على نور﴾ is resumptive and emphatic, with no grammatical position, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the phrase "with no grammatical position" is repeated in the source.]
﴿يهدي﴾: an imperfect verb.
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma. The clause ﴿يهدي الله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿لنوره﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يهدي﴾.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as the object of (يهدي).
﴿يشاء﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent. The clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويضرب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (يضرب) is an imperfect verb in the nominative.
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil.
﴿الأمثال﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿يضرب الله الأمثال﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يهدي﴾.
﴿للناس﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضرب﴾.
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is resumptive, or a conjunction. (الله) is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿بكل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عليم﴾.
﴿شيء﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿عليم﴾: khabar, nominative. The clause ﴿والله بكل شيء عليم﴾ is conjoined to the resumptive clause, or is itself resumptive; on both views it has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
